subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Nils Bohlin's Three-Point Belt
description: One-minute skill: Nils Bohlin's Three-Point Belt.

hook.text: Volvo engineer Nils Bohlin designed ejection seats for jets before switching to car safety.

buildup.text: He saw that lap belts failed because they focused force on one narrow part of the body.

discovery.text: In 1959, Bohlin invented the three-point belt—one strap crossing both the chest and lap.

twist.text: Volvo made the patent free so every carmaker on Earth could use it without paying a cent.

climax.text: The three-point belt has saved over one million lives since its invention.

punchline.text: Volvo gave away its best invention to save strangers.

quiz.question: What did Volvo do with their three-point seatbelt patent?
